title: Dynamic Variables in 4D v12
author: Christophe Keromen, Cabinet de Consultants CKTI
featured_technology: OBJECT Get pointer and pointer-based variable binding

historical_commentary.text: Dynamic form variables and OBJECT Get pointer remain part of the classic 4D language and still function in current, backward-compatible 4D applications built with binary or Project-mode forms, so the mechanism itself is still relevant. However, the specific problem this note solves — reducing memory footprint and managing multi-instantiated component forms by binding form objects dynamically at runtime via a custom XVH component — is less pressing today given vastly larger typical memory budgets and the availability of class-based, object-oriented patterns that offer cleaner encapsulation than pointer-based dynamic variable binding.
related_updates: 4D language classes (introduced v18/v19) provide an object-oriented alternative to bespoke pointer-binding components like XVH for encapsulating form state
Modern hardware/memory budgets have reduced the urgency of the memory-footprint concerns that originally motivated dynamic variables
